```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(ggtext)
library(leaflet) # Warning: highly unstable for pptx output
library(sf)
library(webshot)
library(officer)
library(fontawesome)
library(showtext)
library(pins)
library(here)
library(janitor)

if (interactive()) {
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path
  )$params
}

current_year <- 2025

# Connect to the local pins board
board <- board_folder("C:/Users/JKnapp/OneDrive - Solano County Office of Education/cde_data_pipeline/data/pins")

# Read pins (replace 'solano_dashboard', 'district_geo', 'school_geo' with actual pin names if different)
dashboard_raw <- pin_read(board, "solano_dashboard")
district_geo_raw <- read_sf(here("data/Solano_School_District_Areas_2024-25.geojson"))
school_geo_raw <- read_sf(here("data/Solano_SchoolSites2425.geojson"))

dashboard <- dashboard_raw |>
  filter(county_name == "Solano", reporting_year == current_year) |>
  mutate(
    color = fct_relevel(as_factor(color), "0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
    indicator_color = case_when(
      rtype == "S" & color == 0 ~ "#D3D3D3",
      rtype == "S" & color == 1 ~ "#FF6347",
      rtype == "S" & color == 2 ~ "#FFA500",
      rtype == "S" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFF00",
      rtype == "S" & color == 4 ~ "#3CB371",
      rtype == "S" & color == 5 ~ "#1E90FF",
      rtype == "D" & color == 1 ~ "#CD5C5C",
      rtype == "D" & color == 2 ~ "#FFAF70",
      rtype == "D" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFACD",
      rtype == "D" & color == 4 ~ "#90EE90",
      rtype == "D" & color == 5 ~ "#87CEFA",
      .default = "#737373"
    ),
    leaname = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), district_name, school_name),
    change = replace_na(as.character(change), ""),
    change_arrow = if_else(
      indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "ELPI", "graduation", "college/career"),
      case_match(
        change_level, 
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      ),
      case_match(
        change_level, 
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      )
    ),
    indicator = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(indicator),
      "ELA", "Math", "ELPI", "absenteeism", "graduation", "suspension", "college/career", "science"
    )
  ) |>
  # Future-Proofed Anonymization 
  mutate(
    org_type = if_else(charter_flag == "Y", "Charter", "District", missing = "District")
  ) |>
  group_by(org_type) |>
  mutate(
    # Force SCOE to rank 0 so it's always 'A', sort everything else alphabetically
    sort_rank = if_else(leaname == "Solano County Office of Education", 0, dense_rank(leaname)),
    # Re-rank to ensure continuous 1, 2, 3...
    final_rank = dense_rank(sort_rank), 
    lea_anonymous = paste(org_type, LETTERS[final_rank])
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # Optionally order leaname factor by its new anonymous ranking to keep plots clean
  mutate(
    leaname = fct_reorder(as_factor(leaname), final_rank)
  ) |>
  select(-sort_rank, -final_rank) # clean up temp columns

district_geo <- district_geo_raw |>
  filter(CountyName == "Solano") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(cds = cds_code) |> 
  mutate(
    center_point = st_centroid(geometry),
    lng = st_coordinates(center_point)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(center_point)[, 2]
  )

school_geo <- school_geo_raw |>
  filter(CountyName == "Solano") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(cds = cds_code)

race_ethnicity_groups <- c(
  "Black/African American", "All students", "Filipino", "Hispanic",
  "Multiple Races/Two or more", "White", "American Indian or Alaska Native",
  "Asian", "Pacific Islander"
)

student_program_groups <- c(
  "All students", "English Learner", "Foster Youth", "Homeless Youth",
  "Long-Term English Learner", "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
  "Students with Disabilities"
)

status_colors <- c("grey", "tomato", "orange", "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue")
colors_only <- c("tomato", "orange", "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue")

font_add('fa-solid', here('fonts/fa-solid-900.ttf'))

plot_dashboard_grid <- function(df, 
                                y_facet_col, 
                                box_text_size = 3.3, 
                                box_label_size = 0.8,
                                base_font_size = 12, 
                                strip_font_size = 11,
                                status_colors = c("grey", "tomato", "orange", "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue")) {
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_richtext(
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.5,
      mapping = aes(
        label = if_else(
          indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "science"),
          paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
          paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)
        ),
        fill = color
      ),
      show.legend = FALSE,
      text.color = "black",
      color = "darkgrey",
      label.size = box_label_size,
      size = box_text_size
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
    # Use vars() and {{ }} for unquoted variables in modern facet_grid
    facet_grid(rows = vars({{ y_facet_col }}), cols = vars(indicator), scales = "free", space = "free") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = strip_font_size),
      strip.text.y = element_markdown(
        size = strip_font_size,
        angle = 0,
        vjust = 0.7,
        hjust = 0
      ),
      strip.clip = "off",
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
    )
}

```

# Solano County Dashboard Overview `r current_year`

## Dashboard Colors

![CA Dashboard Performance Colors](../images/CDE%20Colors.png){fig-align="center"}

## `r current_year` District Indicator Colors

```{r}
#| label: district_table
#| echo: FALSE

dashboard |>
  filter(rtype == "D") |>
  group_by(district_name) |>
  count(color) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  select(district_name, `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`) |>
  flextable() |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
  add_header_row(colwidths = c(1, 6), values = c("", "Performance Colors")) |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header", i = 1) |>
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "body", j = "1") |>
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "header", j = "1", i = 2) |>
  bg(bg = "orange", part = "all", j = "2") |>
  bg(bg = "yellow", part = "all", j = "3") |>
  bg(bg = "mediumseagreen", part = "all", j = "4") |>
  bg(bg = "dodgerblue", part = "all", j = "5") |>
  set_header_labels(
    district_name = "District",
    '0' = "No color",
    '1' = "Red (lowest performance)",
    '2' = "Orange",
    '3' = "Yellow",
    '4' = "Green",
    '5' = "Blue (highest performance)"
  ) |>
  width(width = c(1.3, 1, 1.3, 1, 1, 1, 1.3))

```

## `r current_year` Counts of Indicator Colors in Solano County Student Groups: Race/Ethnicity

```{r}
#| label: race_ethnicity_chart
#| echo: FALSE

dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D" | (charter_flag == 'Y' & rtype == "S"),
    color != 0,
    indicator != "science",
    student_group_long %in% race_ethnicity_groups
  ) |>
  mutate(
    color_word = case_match(
      color,
      "1" ~ "Red",
      "2" ~ "Orange",
      "3" ~ "Yellow",
      "4" ~ "Green",
      "5" ~ "Blue",
      .default = ""
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    color_word = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(color_word),
      "Red",
      "Orange",
      "Yellow",
      "Green",
      "Blue"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(student_group_long) |>
  count(color_word) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = color_word, y = n, fill = color_word)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(y = (n / 2) + 2.5, label = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~student_group_long) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_only, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Performance Color",
    y = "Counts of Indicators",
    title = "Count of performance colors assigned to each student race/ethnicity group\nfor all indicators in Solano County LEAs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


```

## `r current_year` County Wide ELA Performance (All students)

```{r}
#| label: ela_map
#| echo: FALSE
#| column: screen

academic_districts <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D",
    student_group_long == "All students",
    indicator == "ELA"
  ) |>
  left_join(district_geo, by = join_by(cds, district_name, county_name)) |>
  st_as_sf()

academic_schools <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "S",
    student_group_long == "All students",
    indicator == "ELA"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    school_geo,
    by = join_by(cds, district_name, county_name, school_name)
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    data = academic_districts,
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    color = "#999999",
    weight = 2,
    fillColor = ~indicator_color
  ) |>
  # addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = districts_with_colors(),
  #                     lng = ~lng,
  #                     lat = ~lat,
  #                     label = ~district_name,
  #                 labelOptions = labelOptions(permanent = T)) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = academic_schools,
    label = ~school_name,
    radius = 6,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 1,
    color = ~indicator_color
  )


```

## `r current_year` Long-Term English Learners: Districts

```{r ltel_counts_districts}

el_counts <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D" | charter_flag == "Y",
    student_group %in% c("ALL", "EL", "LTEL"),
    indicator == "suspension"
  ) |>
  select(leaname, student_group_long, currdenom, rtype) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = student_group_long, values_from = currdenom) |>
  mutate(
    el_percent = paste0(
      round(`English Learner` / `All students` * 100, 2),
      "%"
    ),
    ltel_percent = paste0(
      round(`Long-Term English Learner` / `English Learner` * 100, 2),
      "%"
    )
  )

el_counts |>
  filter(rtype == "D") |>
  select(-rtype) |>
  arrange(leaname) |>
  flextable() |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
  add_footer_row(
    colwidths = c(1, 5),
    values = c(
      "",
      "Values are taken from the denominator of the suspension indicator which is the most inclusive indicator."
    )
  ) |>
  set_header_labels(
    leaname = "LEA",
    `English Learner` = "English Learners",
    `Long-Term English Learner` = "Long-Term English Learners",
    el_percent = "Percent of students that are ELs",
    ltel_percent = "Percent of ELs that are LTELs"
  ) |>
  width(width = c(1.8, 1, 1, 1.2, 1.6, 1.6)) |>
  align(
    align = c("left", "right", "right", "right", "right", "right"),
    part = "all"
  )

```

## `r current_year` Students with disabilities

```{r swd}

showtext_auto()

dashboard |>
  filter(
    student_group_long == "Students with Disabilities",
    rtype == "D" | (rtype == "S" & charter_flag == "Y")
  ) |>
  arrange(rtype) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    mapping = aes(
      label = if_else(
        indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "science"),
        paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
        paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)
      ),
      fill = color
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    text.color = "black",
    color = "darkgrey",
    label.size = 0.8,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
  facet_grid(leaname ~ indicator, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.y = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.7,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```
